test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT included under the right to freedom in the Constitution of India?

options.text: To promote one's religion throughout the territory of India
To assemble peaceably and without arms
The freedom of speech and expression
To move freely throughout the territory of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**To promote one's religion throughout the territory of India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Fundamental Rights** in the Constitution of India are **enshrined in Part III of the Constitution**, which guarantees civil liberties such as freedom of speech, religion, and equality before the law.
 
• These Fundamental Rights were inspired by the Bill of Rights of the United States Constitution, which was adopted in 1791. The Indian Constitution borrowed heavily from the US Constitution, which is why it is often called a 'bag of borrowings.'
 
• Constitution of India provides for **secularism** and **does not allow the promotion of any particular religion over others.**
 
• The Indian Constitution's **Articles 12-35 outline fundamental rights.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **right to freedom** is a fundamental right guaranteed under Article 19 of the Constitution of India.

 
 
• It includes various freedoms such as freedom of speech and expression, assembly without arms, movement throughout the territory of India, etc.
 
 
 
• One of the most important freedoms under the **right to freedom**, which allows individuals to express their opinions and ideas freely without fear of censorship or punishment.
